SELECT a.id AS id, a.source_log_id AS sourceLogId, a.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, a.event_id AS eventId, a.alert_name AS alertName, a.level AS level, a.risk_score AS riskScore, a.description AS description, a.status AS status, a.event_time AS eventTime, a.create_time AS createTime FROM security_alerts a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = a.host_id AND h.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
ORDER BY a.${q.sortColumn} ${q.sortDirection}, a.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM security_alerts a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = a.host_id AND h.tenant_id = a.tenant_id

SELECT a.id AS id, a.source_log_id AS sourceLogId, a.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, a.event_id AS eventId, a.alert_name AS alertName, a.level AS level, a.risk_score AS riskScore, a.description AS description, a.status AS status, a.event_time AS eventTime, a.create_time AS createTime FROM security_alerts a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = a.host_id AND h.tenant_id = a.tenant_id

SELECT a.id AS id, a.source_log_id AS sourceLogId, a.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, a.event_id AS eventId, a.rule_code AS ruleCode, a.alert_name AS alertName, a.level AS level, a.risk_score AS riskScore, a.description AS description, a.evidence_json AS evidenceJson, a.status AS status, a.event_time AS eventTime, a.create_time AS createTime, w.log_type AS logType, w.level AS logLevel, w.username AS logUsername, w.message AS logMessage, w.raw_json AS rawXml FROM security_alerts a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = a.host_id AND h.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN windows_event_logs w ON w.id = a.source_log_id AND w.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM security_alerts WHERE level = #{level} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM security_alerts WHERE status = #{status} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT h.id AS id, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4 FROM hosts h WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY h.id ASC

SELECT a.id AS id, a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.level AS level, a.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, a.alert_name AS alertName, a.description AS description, a.event_time AS eventTime FROM security_alerts a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = a.host_id AND h.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.id > #{afterId} AND a.status = 'new' AND a.level IN ('Critical', 'High') ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
